parsed.rationale: Both participating records carry `is_test: true` in their context flags. `AudioPlayerCoreStateTests.isPlayingFalseAfterStop` (line 88) and `AudioPlayerIdempotencyTests.playAfterStopWorks` (line 164) live in the same test file `Shared/Playback/Tests/PlaybackTests/Behavior/AudioPlayerBehaviorTests.swift` and belong to distinct test classes that verify different behavioral concerns — core state correctness vs. idempotency of the play-after-stop sequence. Although the Jaccard similarity is 0.7, the structural overlap is expected for tests that exercise the same stop/play transition from different angles; merging them would conflate two separate test intents and reduce diagnostic clarity when either assertion fails.
